doc: The Cathedral's three-member party (Crono, Lucca, Frog in the 600 A.D. Cathedral's inner hall, loc 082): the Diablos fight (fx_bat9) and the field after it (fx_party3_field), recipes from power-on with the owner's party bytes poked in (the sheets his game's own fights left, documented in fx_bat9), plus the variants the captures' own provenance made from them.

fixtures.doc: The Diablos fight with Crono's command menu up (the capture is a raw LakeSnes state, no CTLS header).
bat9_lake's WRAM one frame later (the capture differs from bat9_lake.state's by the frame counter $0400 + 1 and that frame's own work: its provenance was a 1-frame --peek of it).
The field after the Diablos fight: loc 082, Crono, Lucca and Frog, control back (the capture's own recipe from bat9_lake: A mashed 8 of every 20 frames 115 times, then 300 frames).
The X menu's Form screen open on party3_field (X, Right x4, A: the capture's own recorded pad), so the menu-open stat pass has run.

party3_field with Lucca's and Frog's sheet bytes +0x41..+0x4E set to FF (the capture differs from party3_field.lakewram by exactly those 28 bytes): a fresh sheet whose battle block the fight must build itself.

catedral_user.lakewram (tools/fixtures/rest.json: cathedral_entry, Crono and Lucca at the 600 A.D. Cathedral's south door) with Marle in party slot 2 ($2982 = 01) -- the capture's own provenance, and the byte tools/ow_follower_cmp.py party3 pokes on the cartridge's side (PEEK_POKE on catedral_user.state).
